chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 563: The Divine Farmer’s Trap & Yu Wei’s Heartbreak
chapter_meta_description: The Godking gives Yu Wei her final order. Ji Ning punishes a mischievous Brightmoon. Daofather Crimsonbright unveils a game-changing poison from the Divine Farmer that will decide the Realm War.
og_title: The Godking’s Command and the Divine Farmer’s Gambit
og_description: Ji Ning enjoys a warm family moment with Yu Wei and Brightmoon, unaware that the Godking has already activated the final phase of his plan. A world-shaking poison goes into play.
twitter_description: A tender family scene hides the cold machinery of war. The Divine Farmer’s new weapon promises to break the stalemate, but at what cost?

lore_anchors.definition: A title for the supreme ruler of the Seamless Gate; a master manipulator who implants soul-brands in his followers to ensure absolute loyalty and control.
A supreme war construct possessing Daofather-level strength and extreme toughness; virtually indestructible except by a Daofather's personal effort.
One of the legendary Three Sovereigns of Humanity; a cosmic power in the Desolate Era setting, the father of agriculture and herbal medicine.
Colossal battle avatars formed from coordinated immortal cultivator formations, representing the concentrated might of hundreds of Celestial Immortals and Loose Immortals.
An advanced stage of immortality achieved by a Ki Refiner who has perfected the Five Energies and undergone a transformation of their Golden Core into Pure Yang.
A treasure that contains an independent, idyllic world; used by Ji Ning and Yu Wei as a private sanctuary to raise their daughter Brightmoon.
Not present in this chapter; removed.
The newborn daughter of Ji Ning and Yu Wei. Born to top-tier cultivators, she is precocious, intelligent, and possesses powerful innate abilities, but lacks discipline.
A supreme Daofather of the Three Realms and the ruler of the Crimsonbright Realmverse; a key commander in the war against the Seamless Gate.
A True Immortal who serves as a representative and messenger for the Divine Farmer, Sovereign of Humanity.
